questions.q: In right triangle $ABC$ shown for a support frame at the municipal library, $\angle C = 90^\circ$. Based on the leg lengths labeled in the figure, what is the area of $\triangle ABC$ in square units?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $24$. Reading the right triangle diagram, the two perpendicular legs have lengths $6$ and $8$. The area of the right triangle is $\frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 8 = 24$.

questions.q: In right triangle $ABC$ shown for a support frame at the coastal aquarium, $\angle C = 90^\circ$. Based on the leg lengths labeled in the figure, what is the length of the hypotenuse $AB$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $15$. Reading the right triangle diagram, the two legs have lengths $9$ and $12$. By the Pythagorean theorem, $AB = \sqrt{9^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{225} = 15$.

questions.q: In a right triangle survey at the botanical conservatory, $\sin(18^\circ) = \cos(x^\circ)$, where $0 < x < 90$. What is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $72$. By the complementary angle theorem for right-triangle trigonometry, $\sin(\theta) = \cos(90^\circ - \theta)$. Therefore, $x = 90 - 18 = 72$.

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In the $xy$-plane for the municipal library layout, the equation $x^2 - 6x + y^2 + 8y = 0$ defines a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $5$. Complete the square for $x$ and $y$: $(x - 3)^2 + (y + 4)^2 = 0 + 9 + 16 = 25.$ Thus the radius is $r = \sqrt{25} = 5$.

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: A cylindrical water column at the community theater has a base radius of $5$ feet and a height of $7$ feet. If the volume of the cylinder is $k\pi$ cubic feet, what is the value of $k$?
questions.answer: **Answer:** $175$. Using the cylinder volume formula $V = \pi r^2 h$, we have $V = \pi (5)^2 (7) = 175\pi$. Therefore, $k = 175$.

sections.heading: Part II — Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs): Challenging Synthesis (38–45)

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In a model for the honeybee apiary, in a calculation for the wildlife sanctuary (case 36), what is the surface area of a cube with edge length 4 cm?
questions.answer: A cube has 6 congruent square faces: $SA = 6s^2 = 6(4^2) = 6(16) = 96 \text{ cm}^2$.

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In a model for the carpentry workshop, in a circle, a central angle of $60^\circ$ intercepts what fraction of the entire circumference?

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In a model for the community orchard, in a calculation for the textile workshop (case 39), what is the area of a parallelogram with base 12 cm and height 5 cm?
questions.answer: $\text{Area} = \text{base} \times \text{height} = 12 \times 5 = 60 \text{ cm}^2$.

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In a model for the local farmers market, a rectangle has perimeter 36 cm and length = twice width. What is the area in cm²?
questions.answer: $2(2w+w)=36 \implies 6w=36 \implies w=6, l=12. \text{ Area} = 6 \times 12 = 72 \text{ cm}^2$

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In the $xy$-plane for the orchestra hall layout, the equation $x^2 - 12x + y^2 + 10y = 39$ defines a circle. What is the radius of the circle?
questions.answer: Complete the square for $x$ and $y$: $(x - 6)^2 + (y + 5)^2 = 39 + 36 + 25 = 100.$ Thus the radius is $r = \sqrt{100} = 10$.
